prompt.project_info: Cinematic fashion portrait at a seaside Mediterranean villa terrace during golden hour.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with dark hair in a messy bun and soft face-framing strands, poised confident expression, classic red lipstick and natural skin texture, wearing a red satin backless slip dress with thin straps, small gold hoops, delicate bracelets and rings.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 4:5 three-quarter portrait from behind, body turned away while head looks over shoulder, face and red dress primary, white villa railing leading toward subject, ocean horizon and green hills in elegant negative sky space.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural warm sunset light with soft sky fill, controlled satin sheen, medium contrast, pastel sky gradients, minimal luxury coastal serenity.
prompt.technical_specs: Sony A7R V look, 85mm prime, f/2.0, sharp eyes and face with soft falloff, fine film grain, subtle horizon halation, no text or logos.
